title: Cop hit by friendly fire
article: At least one of the bullets that struck Const. Keith Calderwood during a drug raid in this central Ontario town Wednesday came from a police firearm, the province's Special Investigations Unit says.
The SIU also identified the man who was fatally shot during the raid as Corey Aaron Armstrong, 21, of Toronto.
QMI Agency has confirmed from several sources that he was armed and shot at officers.
Sources also confirm that Armstrong was shot by more than one police officer.
Calderwood, an officer based in Peterborough, Ont., remains in stable condition in hospital in Toronto.
An SIU release doesn't say exactly how or where Calderwood was injured.
Meanwhile, SIU spokesman Frank Phillips said investigators have now opened a second investigation into Calderwood's injuries, one separate from the investigation into Armstrong's death.
Five people were arrested in the incident, but only one person -- Jennifer Nicholson, 39, of Bowmanville, Ont. -- was charged with breach of recognizance.
